items.text: Jadarian Price placed on IR with chest injury (min 4 weeks); Levitan detailed prior role erosion (GL to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, Charbonnet practice).
items.why: Schefter report aggravated at practice; ETR listed OUT; signed Velus Jones.
items.implication: SEA RB committee with Wilson/Holani; Charbonnet potential return soon.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup RBs elevated short-term; Price long-term still viable per Levitan eye test.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Week 4 after hip injury; expected to play possibly with snap limits per Levitan notes.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury list; Schefter/Rapoport corroborate expected to play; McVay notes look sharp, possible snap count.
items.implication: WR1/2 upgrade return; Davante Adams value may dip slightly on volume.
items.opportunity: High route/target share expected if unlimited; monitor snaps.

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN returning from hamstring; Levitan flags elite DvP vs Cowboys (+7.3% WR scoring) and high Texans implied total.
items.why: ETR list + Rapoport/Texans PR good to go; limited practices but cleared.
items.implication: Elite WR1 start in great matchup.
items.opportunity: High target share vs soft secondary; red-zone upside.

items.text: Justin Jefferson ruled OUT Week 4 with ankle injury; ETR/Levitan note opportunity for Jordan Addison vs soft secondary.
items.why: Schefter list + ETR OUT; ankle from Week 3, missed practice.
items.implication: Vikings WR downgrade; Addison becomes primary target.
items.opportunity: Addison high target/route share home vs borderline secondary.

items.text: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) and Dallas Goedert (knee) OUT vs Rams; Levitan notes Eagles situation worse without them + Baun.
items.implication: Eagles offense downgraded; Hurts/ remaining WRs impacted; Wicks or others may see more.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining pass-catchers; TE streamers elevated.

items.text: Keenan Allen downgraded to OUT (groin) vs Commanders; elevates Downs/others; Schefter notes Westbrook-Ikhine elevated.
items.implication: IND WR volume to Downs (Berry LOVE too).

items.text: Ladd McConkey Q (foot) after LP-DNP-LP trend; already dealt with cracked rib earlier.
items.why: ETR Q list + Levitan practice trend note.
items.implication: Risky start; monitor inactives; backups elevate if OUT.
items.opportunity: If active, still solid WR2/3; if OUT, LAC WR volume shifts.

items.text: Jordan Addison opportunity peaks with Jefferson OUT; home vs borderline NFL secondary.
items.why: Levitan: 'moment Addison truthers have been waiting for'; prior high targets last week.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad); concentrates Jets offense to Wilson/Sadiq per reports.
items.why: ETR/Schefter lists; quad from Week 3, week-to-week.
items.implication: Braelon Allen lead back; Wilson target share spikes.
items.opportunity: Wilson high-end WR1/2; Allen RB2/flex upside.

items.text: De'Von Achane OUT (season-ending ACL per reports); ETR lists with Caleb Douglas.
items.why: ETR OUT list; ACL tear Week 3 confirmed in multiple reports.
items.implication: MIA RB committee/handcuffs elevate; long-term zero.
items.opportunity: Backup RBs and pass-catchers see more work.

items.text: Jaylen Warren LOVE: 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out again; workhorse vs CLE.
items.why: Berry: full workhorse role, CLE allows 88+ yards to RBs every game.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love LOVE: 26 touches last week (RB5 util), double-digit target share every game; vs NYG allowing 5.1 YPC.
items.why: Berry notes utilization spike and matchup.

items.text: Omarion Hampton HATE: low util (RB27), 3.5% targets, 25% routes, snaps down to 42%; SEA stout vs RBs (2.9 YPC).
items.why: Berry: poor usage profile and tough matchup.

items.text: Drake London LOVE with Penix: 35%+ career target share/104 ypg with him; 43.5% last week; NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
